patterns.name: Phase 1 dispatch publish/amend E2E
steps: persist dispatch in company source of truth
show on company calendar
show on each employee My Dispatch
create/update the same Google Calendar event
send LINE notification
allow employee acknowledgement
show acknowledgement to coordinator
invalidate prior acknowledgement on material amendment
update Google Calendar projection
send LINE amendment notification
preserve before/after audit record

source.claim: Phase 1 acceptance flow; all steps must succeed.

patterns.name: Phase 1 bounded offline continuity
steps: load previously synchronized current/next dispatch and site summary without network
queue an allow-listed dispatch acknowledgement with stable idempotency key
restore connectivity and synchronize company-system write before provider side effects
reject stale acknowledgement if dispatch version changed while offline
show conflict/rejected state to the user
do not expose installable PWA/native-app artifacts

source.claim: Conditional acceptance pattern activated by project selection.

patterns.name: Approved labor time drives labor cost
steps: record planned dispatch
record actual work/attendance independently
submit and approve labor time
post labor cost from approved labor time
adjust approved time with traceable reversal/adjustment
recompute project P&L without losing history

source.claim: Conditional acceptance pattern activated by project selection.

patterns.name: Accounting sync and reconciliation
steps: emit accounting integration record from authoritative project/procurement/billing source
deliver through provider adapter with stable idempotency key
record provider identifier only in integration boundary
retry without duplicate provider transaction
reconcile source and provider state
surface unreconciled failures

source.claim: Conditional acceptance pattern activated by project selection.
